high_level_description: The image shows a man holding a peacock in what appears to be an outdoor setting. The man is wearing a dark polo shirt and a white cap. He has a beard and mustache and is looking directly at the camera with a serious expression. The peacock is perched on his arm, with its head turned slightly to the side, showing its vibrant blue neck and part of its tail feathers. The background features a railing that separates the area where the man and the peacock are standing from a body of water, possibly a canal or a river.
